name: Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Stand tall beside a wall or sturdy chair, placing your inside hand lightly on it for balance with your weight shifted onto your inside standing leg.
Brace your core, keep your toes pointing forward, and maintain a tiny unlock in your standing knee.
Lift your straight outside leg smoothly out to the side by squeezing your outer glute without leaning your torso away.
Lower your leg slowly back beside your standing foot, and switch sides after completing one leg.
tips: Keep your torso completely upright instead of tipping sideways to lift your leg higher.
Keep your working foot pointing straight ahead rather than rotating your toes up toward the ceiling.
